QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_39

question.text: GST on fees paid by a Cat III AIF to external service providers (custodian, trustee, fund admin) is charged at the rate of:

explanation.text: The Logic: GST on management/trusteeship fees and other external financial-service provider fees paid by an AIF is charged at 18%. AIFs generally cannot recover this GST as input credit, so it functions as a cost drag. The Trap: 12% is a concessional rate that does not apply here. 28% is the consumer-goods rate. 'Exempt' misreads the statute. Note: The 18% rate is illustrated in the worked GST example in the workbook covering external service-provider fees.
